name: @meir-labs/skill-qa-army
description: A full QA regression run by an army of agents: the strongest model writes the test plan, automated, browser, and code-reading testers run rounds, and new verified issues become subtickets under one master regression ticket; reopened tickets are detached from their parent, each with a plain-English TL;DR. Finds issues, never fixes them. Works in Claude Code and Codex.
author: Meir Rosenschein
